notes: FIX SmartTraffic HTTP 500 (Internal Server Error) khi dang bai. DO THAT: dung CHINH payload do, lan dau server tra 500 ca 2 luot, thu lai sau do -> 201 trong 0,4s. Vay 500 la loi TAM THOI phia SmartTraffic, khong phai loi noi dung (payload tieng Viet co dau, 60.870 ky tu, 10 chuong, 9 {{nextpage}} van dang duoc binh thuong). Ban cu chi gui 2 lan roi DUNG (cach nhau 0,5s) nen 500 tam thoi lam hong ca luot chay. Nay: gap 5xx thi GUI LAI CHINH payload do voi gian cach tang dan 20s/40s/60s/80s (smarttraffic_retry_count=4, smarttraffic_retry_delay=20 trong config, sua duoc khong can vao code). Giu nguyen slug nen neu lan dau thuc ra da luu bai thi lan sau la bai trung, KHONG sinh -2/-3. Het luot thu ma van 5xx thi DUNG HAN (khong thu payload rut gon nua, vi payload rut gon dung CUNG slug de sinh bai trung). Da test: gia lap server tra 500, 500 roi 201 -> tool thu lai dung 2 lan va dang thanh cong.
